name: event-platform
description: Event invitation & QR ticket management platform

scripts.setup: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @event-platform/shared" "npm run dev -w @event-platform/api" "npm run dev -w @event-platform/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @event-platform/api && npm run build -w @event-platform/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @event-platform/api && npm run test:integration -w @event-platform/api && npm run test -w @event-platform/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @event-platform/api && npm run typecheck -w @event-platform/web
